director.chapterArc: Tactical collapse and survival under siege
director.restraintNote: Maintain clinical detachment during combat; let the horror of absence (silence, missing warmth) land through pacing rather than volume.

cues.delivery: Narrator establishes the oppressive atmosphere; flat and shadowless.
cues.from: The south mouth of the cut swallowed them the way a door swallows a room.
cues.through: The south mouth of the cut swallowed them the way a door swallows a room.
cues.reason: Scene setting requires neutral tone to contrast with later action.

cues.delivery: Wyck's voice is flat and factual; narrator describes the wrongness of the walk without inflection.
cues.from: "There's something in the road behind us," Wyck said.
cues.through: Except it had no face. It had a head. The head had no arrangement on the front of it — just gray, crowded, the color of wet ash, like a shape somebody had started and then set aside.
cues.reason: Establishes threat through observation rather than alarm.

cues.delivery: Garrick's dialogue is delivered with tactical precision; no fear in his voice.
cues.through: "More than one," said Garrick, "is why we're going to get this cart through that gap in the next four minutes."
cues.reason: Character distinction: Garrick treats tragedy as logistics.

cues.delivery: Marta's action is described with clinical precision; Milo's reaction is quiet awe.
cues.from: Marta Faust stepped back from the wheel, put her feet a little apart, and set her hands out at waist height with the palms turned down, the way a woman settles a sheet onto a bed.
cues.through: Toren had known Marta Faust since before he could remember. She had set his wrist when he was six. She had made the poultice that got his grandmother through the winter of the bad cough. She had never in his whole life done a single thing that looked like this, and he understood, with a strange cold clarity, that she had been able to do it the entire time and it had simply never come up.
cues.reason: Reveal of Marta's power requires a shift to observational clarity.

cues.delivery: Internal monologue section; narrator adopts Toren's analytical but panicked rhythm.
cues.from: Here is what nobody tells you.
cues.through: He tried again. He got the same half-inch of seam and the same guttering, and this time it hurt — a thin, unpleasant wrongness behind the ribs, like pulling a muscle in a place that has no muscles.
cues.reason: Shift to internal POV requires distinct pacing from external narration.

cues.delivery: Action sequence; staccato delivery for Toren's failure and success with the hook.
cues.from: A Husk came around the near side of the cart.
cues.through: "I'm not complaining." Wyck was already climbing back up. "It's just not a sword."

cues.delivery: Rapid exchange of commands; Garrick's voice is sharp and authoritative.
cues.from: "Garrick!" Marta called. "I can hold this end! Do something with the other one!"
cues.through: "You'll call," Garrick agreed, and went north again.
cues.reason: Escalation requires faster tempo but controlled volume.

cues.delivery: Dessa's calling is rhythmic and precise; Toren's internal realization about the Ember.
cues.from: She called for four minutes and never once touched one of them.
cues.through: "Good," Milo said, and swung the chain again.
cues.reason: Shift from action to tactical discovery.

cues.delivery: Toren's realization of the Ember's nature; Garrick's roar is a tactical correction.
cues.from: Toren's hook went out and came back. Out and back.
cues.through: It was the last thing his father ever said to him about the Ember.
cues.reason: Character arc moment: Toren understands his tool.

cues.delivery: Collapse of the plan; Marta's failure and Toren's loss of power described with cold clarity.
cues.from: Then the tactical problem changed, the way it always does, and it changed in the one direction they had not planned for.
cues.through: The way out was above them. It was full. It was coming down.
cues.reason: Climax requires emotional restraint to maximize impact.

pauses.reason: Scene reset: entering the cut.

pauses.after: He said it in exactly the voice he used for everything. Toren turned around with his heart still at its ordinary speed, because Wyck's voice had given him no reason to do otherwise.
pauses.reason: Completed thought on Wyck's voice and Toren's reaction.
Emphasis on the wrongness of movement.

Isolating the threat name for impact.
Emphasis on Garrick's clinical assessment of death.

pauses.after: They did not get four minutes.
pauses.reason: Major emotional landing: The plan fails immediately.
Light continuation for Milo's reaction to Marta's power.
Preparation for the internal sensation description.

pauses.after: Toren did not think about it.
pauses.reason: Major emotional landing: Toren acts without thinking; realization of the hook.

pauses.before: That was the whole of it
pauses.reason: Emphasis on Toren's lack of thought before action.

pauses.after: Then he walked north, alone, into the eight feet between the wall and the slab.
pauses.reason: Speaker reset to narrative description of Garrick's position.

pauses.after: Then Dessa went up the slab.
pauses.reason: Completed thought on Dessa's action.
Speaker reset: Wyck receives the command to back out.

pauses.after: That was the discovery, and he made it in the worst possible classroom. Every single time he tried — every time he set his jaw and reached and gripped and thought now, come on, now — nothing happened, or the seam opened a finger's width and closed again. And every time he stopped, every time something came at Milo or Dessa or the wheel and his hands went out ahead of his thinking, the metal ran and the hook was simply there, as though it had been waiting behind a door for him to stop leaning on it.
pauses.reason: Major emotional landing: Toren's discovery of how his Ember works.
Isolating the pivotal realization about agency vs. tool.
Emphasis on the second lesson learned.

pauses.after: His father's answer came back off both walls. "Then we give her twenty! Everybody south! To the gully!"
pauses.reason: Speaker reset to Garrick's tactical decision.
Isolating the finality of Toren's power loss.

pauses.after: The way out was above them. It was full. It was coming down.
pauses.reason: Major emotional landing: The way out is blocked; cliffhanger.
